chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Jameel ibn Darraj, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The one who eats a quince, Allah (Exalted and Majestic) will make wisdom speak from his tongue for forty mornings.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of eating quince according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), linking the consumption of quince (safarjal) to the divine bestowal of hikmah (wisdom) and eloquence for forty mornings. This reflects the Shia tradition of 'tibb al-nabawi' (Prophetic medicine), where specific foods are believed to purify the body and enhance intellectual and spiritual faculties, facilitating the articulation of divine truth.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Jameel Bin Darraj, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who eats a Quince Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would Make his tongue speak wisdom for forty mornings’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Jamil ibn Darraj who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If one eats quince Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, makes his tongue to speak wisdom for forty mornings.’”
